pages.text: Have you ever met one of those shady merchants that just appear on your lawn?$(p)Those are called $(9)Wandering Traders$().$(p)Typically they only sell hot garbage.

However, Apotheosis adds a ton of new trades to their tables so they are actually worth interacting with.$(p)These trades include items like $(9)Beacons$() and $(9)Totems of Undying$(), as well as random $(9)Affix Items$(), priced in emeralds plus their repair material.
In $(9)Summit$() and $(9)Pinnacle$(), traders may also offer powerful preset gear. Most of it requires Apothic Enchanting or Apothic Spawners to be installed.
Apotheosis also makes Wandering Traders appear more often, stay for a shorter time, and allows them to spawn underground (configurable).
